definition.en: The LearnPack Instructional Designer is an AI-powered assistant that generates complete training courses from source material, making regeneration faster and more cost effective than manual updates.
definition.es: El Instructional Designer de LearnPack es una IA que genera cursos completos a partir de material fuente, haciendo que recrearlos sea más rápido y rentable que mantenerlos.

control.question: Will I lose instructional control if courses are AI generated?
control.answer: No. The AI generates a complete draft, but you have full control to review, edit, and refine before publishing. The Notion-style editor makes adjustments fast and intuitive.

changes.question: How do teams handle frequent content changes?
changes.answer: Instead of patching existing courses, teams upload the updated source material and regenerate a new version. This is faster than editing and produces cleaner results.

lms.question: Does LearnPack work with our LMS?
lms.answer: Yes. LearnPack exports SCORM packages compatible with all major learning management systems. You can also embed courses directly or integrate via API.
